facts.rationale: Updates the historical input field spelling and preserves the exact guards and sole write.
facts.value: Reads mv.co.capturewait.x0, p_ftCommonData->x3AC and input.pressed_buttons. If the counter is below the threshold and HSD_PAD_XY is present in pressed_buttons, writes mv.co.capturewait.xC = true. It does not clear the latch or change motion state.

facts.rationale: Preserves the explicit current stick sample index.
facts.value: Reads input.lstick[0].y and p_ftCommonData->tap_jump_threshold and returns the inclusive threshold comparison. It writes no fighter state.

facts.rationale: Makes sample selection and short-circuit release behavior explicit.
facts.value: Returns true exactly when input.lstick[0].y >= tap_jump_threshold. There is no fresh-stick-edge or timing-window test. At grab-timer expiration, CaptureWaitHi_Anim calls this predicate only if the buffered release byte is zero; true selects fn_800DC070, while false selects CaptureCut.

facts.rationale: Replaces the obsolete input.x668 spelling while preserving the producer-consumer relationship.
facts.value: Forwards gobj unchanged to fn_800DC014. That helper reads capturewait.x0, common threshold x3AC and input.pressed_buttons, and conditionally sets capturewait.xC on an early X/Y press. The shared animation callback later consumes the buffered release byte at nonpositive grab time to select fn_800DC070 or CaptureCut.

facts.rationale: Uses the current field spelling and explicitly connects both low-state wrappers to shared processing.
facts.value: Forwards gobj unchanged to fn_800DC014. That helper compares capturewait.x0 with common threshold x3AC, reads X/Y bits from input.pressed_buttons and conditionally sets capturewait.xC. Low animation delegates to the high animation callback, which consumes the buffered release byte when the grab timer expires.
